camera_processor.back_processing: The one/back branch skips the CGImage constructor with forced orientation 6.

crop_processing.unchanged_aspect_branch: Returns the same retained UIImage, preserving its orientation.
crop_processing.effect: UIImage draw applies orientation; the forced orientation is rendered into pixels on the crop/resize branch, rather than discarded.

camera_kit_delegate.scope_conclusion: No forced orientation 6 is established in this callback. Keep its replacement bytes upright; do not extend the processor-specific compensation to this separate route.

minimal_fix_scope: Only a physical front-camera replacement sent to one of the two exact CameraPhotoCaptureProcessor names receives inverse EXIF-5 pixel compensation. Back-camera and CameraKitData delegate paths retain their existing bytes.
validation_needed: Use a non-square four-corner image, JPEG dimensions and orientation=1, and an independent macOS ImageIO EXIF-5 rendering oracle to prove the compensated pixels return upright. On-device behavior remains a separate check.
privacy: No raw crash report, runtime address, device identifier, user identifier, UUID, certificate subject or input access URL is included.
